title: Les Mills Class Guide
meta_desc: Discover the best Les Mills classes for your fitness goals, including BodyPump, BodyCombat, and RPM. Find a gym near you with our comparison tool.
intro: Les Mills is a household name in New Zealand, with a range of high-energy classes to suit all fitness levels. From strength training to cardio and yoga, there's a Les Mills class to help you achieve your goals. In this guide, we'll break down the most popular classes, including BodyPump, BodyCombat, BodyBalance, RPM, SH'BAM, and GRIT.

sections.heading: Introduction to Les Mills Classes
sections.body: Les Mills classes are designed to be fun, engaging, and challenging. Each class is carefully choreographed to music, with expert instructors guiding you through the workout. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced athlete, there's a Les Mills class to suit your needs. BodyPump, for example, is a weights-based class that's perfect for building strength and toning muscle. BodyCombat, on the other hand, is a high-energy martial arts-inspired workout that's great for cardio and stress relief.
list: BodyPump: weights-based class for strength and toning
BodyBalance: yoga and Pilates-based class for flexibility and relaxation

sections.heading: Calorie Burn and Intensity
sections.body: Les Mills classes vary in terms of calorie burn and intensity. RPM, for example, is a high-intensity indoor cycling class that can burn up to 600 calories per session. SH'BAM, on the other hand, is a fun and energetic dance-based class that's designed to be low-impact and accessible to all fitness levels. GRIT, a high-intensity interval training (HIIT) class, is perfect for those looking to push themselves to the limit.

sections.heading: Which Class is Right for You?
sections.body: With so many Les Mills classes to choose from, it can be difficult to know where to start. If you're new to group fitness classes, we recommend starting with a lower-intensity class like BodyBalance or SH'BAM. If you're looking to challenge yourself, try RPM or GRIT. Many New Zealand gyms, including Les Mills, City Fitness, and Jetts, offer a range of Les Mills classes, so you're sure to find one that suits your needs. Don't forget to check out Exercise NZ's subsidised gym scheme, which can save you 40-70% on gym membership.
list: Start with a lower-intensity class like BodyBalance or SH'BAM
Challenge yourself with RPM or GRIT
Check out Exercise NZ's subsidised gym scheme for discounts

sections.heading: Getting Started
sections.body: Once you've chosen a Les Mills class, it's time to get started. Arrive at least 10-15 minutes before the class to meet the instructor and get familiar with the equipment. Wear comfortable clothing and shoes, and bring a water bottle to stay hydrated. Most New Zealand gyms offer a free trial or introductory session, so be sure to take advantage of this to try out a new class.
list: Bring a water bottle to stay hydrated

sections.heading: Find a Gym Near You
sections.body: With so many great Les Mills classes to choose from, it's time to find a gym near you that offers them. Use our comparison tool to find a gym that suits your needs and budget. Whether you're in Auckland, Wellington, or Christchurch, we've got you covered.
